name: @ponti-studios/calendar
description: Apple Calendar CLI for macOS - manage calendars and events from the command line
author: Joar G.P. <joargp@gmail.com>

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc && swift build -c release --package-path ../calendar-helper && cp package.json dist/package.json && cp ../calendar-helper/.build/release/calendar-helper dist/calendar-helper
scripts.prepublishOnly: pnpm lint && pnpm format && pnpm test
